fullPassage: Christine was a cat owner who loved her furry companion, Leo. One morning, she noticed that Leo was not feeling well. Concerned for her beloved cat, Christine decided to take him to the animal hospital. As she always brought Leo to this hospital, she was certain that the vet knew well about Leo. She desperately hoped Leo got the necessary care as soon as possible. The waiting room was filled with other pet owners. Finally, it was Leo’s turn to see the vet. Christine watched as the vet gently examined him. The vet said, “I think Leo has a minor infection.” “Infection? Will he be okay?” asked Christine. “We need to do some tests to see if he is infected. But for the tests, it’s best for Leo to stay here,” replied the vet. It was heartbreaking for Christine to leave Leo at the animal hospital, but she had to accept it was for the best. “I’ll call you with updates as soon as we know anything,” said the vet. Throughout the day, Christine anxiously awaited news about Leo. Later that day, the phone rang and it was the vet. “The tests revealed a minor infection. Leo needs some medication and rest, but he’ll be back to his playful self soon.” Relieved to hear the news, Christine rushed back to the animal hospital to pick up Leo. The vet provided detailed instructions on how to administer the medication and shared tips for a speedy recovery. Back at home, Christine created a comfortable space for Leo to rest and heal. She patted him with love and attention, ensuring that he would recover in no time. As the days passed, Leo gradually regained his strength and playful spirit.

❌ ② delighted(기뻐하는): Leo가 아프므로 부적절
❌ ③ calmly(차분하게): 원문은 anxiously(불안하게)
❌ ④ uncomfortable(불편한): 회복을 위한 공간이므로 comfortable
❌ ⑤ 세 단어 모두 부적절
det.tip: Concerned(걱정하는)↔Delighted(기뻐하는), anxiously(불안하게)↔calmly(차분하게), comfortable(편안한)↔uncomfortable(불편한)

det.korean: Christine은 Leo를 위해 최선이라는 것을 받아들여야(accept) 했다. ② reject(거부하다)는 accept의 반의어로 부적절.
det.analysis:
❌ ② reject(거부하다): 원문은 accept(받아들이다) → "it was for the best"를 받아들인다
✅ ① certain(확신하는): 원문 일치
✅ ③ minor(가벼운): 원문 일치
✅ ④ medication(약): 원문 일치
✅ ⑤ administer(투여하다): 원문 일치
det.tip: accept(받아들이다) ↔ reject(거부하다) — "it was for the best"를 거부하는 것은 문맥상 부자연스러움

questions.passage: <u>Concerned</u> for her beloved cat, Christine decided to take him to the animal hospital.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 Concerned의 의미와 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: Concerned = 걱정하는, worried = 걱정하는 → 동의어
det.analysis:
✅ ③ worried(걱정하는): Concerned의 동의어
❌ ① rejected(거부된): 다른 의미
❌ ② doubted(의심한): 다른 의미
❌ ④ ignored(무시한): 반의어에 가까움
det.tip: Concerned = worried = anxious = 걱정하는, 염려하는

questions.passage: <u>Relieved</u> to hear the news, Christine rushed back to the animal hospital to pick up Leo.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 Relieved의 의미와 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: Relieved = 안도한, eased = 안심한/편해진 → 의미 유사
det.analysis:
✅ ② eased(안심한): Relieved의 동의어
❌ ① annoyed(짜증난): 다른 의미
❌ ③ depressed(우울한): 반의어에 가까움
❌ ④ confused(혼란스러운): 다른 의미
det.tip: Relieved = eased = comforted = 안도한, 안심한

questions.passage: The vet provided detailed instructions on how to <u>administer</u> the medication.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 administer의 의미와 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: administer the medication = 약을 투여하다, give = 주다/투여하다 → 의미 유사
det.analysis:
✅ ① give(주다/투여하다): administer의 동의어 (약을 투여하다)
❌ ② produce(생산하다): 다른 의미
❌ ③ receive(받다): 반의어
❌ ④ prescribe(처방하다): 의사가 처방하는 것이지 투여하는 것이 아님
det.tip: administer medication = give medication = 약을 투여하다

questions.passage: Throughout the day, Christine <u>anxiously</u> awaited news about Leo.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 anxiously의 의미와 가장 먼 것은?

det.korean: anxiously = 불안하게 ↔ indifferently = 무관심하게
det.analysis:
❌ ④ indifferently(무관심하게): anxiously의 반의어 → 가장 먼 의미
✅ ① eagerly(간절히): 유사한 긴장감
✅ ② impatiently(조급하게): 유사한 초조함
✅ ③ nervously(초조하게): 동의어
det.tip: anxiously = nervously = 불안하게 ↔ indifferently = 무관심하게

questions.passage: As the days passed, Leo <u>gradually</u> regained his strength and playful spirit.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 gradually의 의미와 가장 먼 것은?

det.korean: gradually = 서서히 ↔ rapidly = 빠르게, 급격히
det.analysis:
❌ ② rapidly(빠르게): gradually의 반의어 → 가장 먼 의미
✅ ① slowly(느리게): 유사어
✅ ③ steadily(꾸준히): 유사어
✅ ④ progressively(점진적으로): 동의어
det.tip: gradually = slowly = steadily = progressively(서서히) ↔ rapidly = suddenly(급격히)

questions.passage: Christine was a cat owner who loved her furry companion, Leo. One morning, she noticed that Leo was not feeling well. __________ for her beloved cat, Christine decided to take him to the animal hospital.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: Leo가 아파서 사랑하는 고양이를 걱정하며(Concerned) 병원에 데려가기로 했다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② concerned(걱정하는): "beloved cat"이 아프므로 걱정하는 것이 자연스러움
❌ ① indifferent(무관심한): 사랑하는 고양이에게 무관심할 수 없음
❌ ③ amused(즐거워하는): 아픈 상황에 부적절
❌ ④ relieved(안도한): 아직 치료 전이므로 안도할 상황이 아님
det.tip: Concerned for = ~을 걱정하여 → 분사구문으로 이유를 나타냄

questions.passage: It was __________ for Christine to leave Leo at the animal hospital, but she had to accept it was for the best.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 사랑하는 Leo를 병원에 두고 오는 것은 가슴 아픈(heartbreaking) 일이었다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ heartbreaking(가슴 아픈): 사랑하는 반려동물을 두고 와야 하는 상황
❌ ① joyful(기쁜): 반대 감정
❌ ② boring(지루한): 문맥과 무관
❌ ④ amusing(재미있는): 반대 감정
det.tip: heartbreaking = 가슴이 찢어지는, 매우 슬픈 — "but she had to accept"과 역접 관계

questions.passage: The vet provided detailed instructions on how to __________ the medication and shared tips for a speedy recovery.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 수의사가 약을 투여하는(administer) 방법에 대해 자세한 지침을 제공했다.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ administer(투여하다): "the medication"과 자연스럽게 결합 → 약을 투여하다
❌ ① ignore(무시하다): 약을 무시하는 것은 부적절
❌ ② refuse(거부하다): 약을 거부하는 것은 부적절
❌ ③ delay(지연하다): "speedy recovery"와 모순
det.tip: administer medication = give medication = 약을 투여하다 — 의료 맥락에서 자주 사용

questions.passage: The vet said, “I think Leo has a <u>minor</u> infection.”
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 minor의 문맥적 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: minor infection = 가벼운(경미한) 감염
det.analysis:
✅ ① 가벼운, 경미한: minor infection = 경미한 감염
❌ ② 미성년의: a minor(미성년자)
❌ ③ 부전공의: minor in (부전공)
❌ ④ 단조의: minor key(단조)
det.tip: minor: 경미한(가장 흔한 의미) | 미성년자(명사) | 부전공(학업) | 단조(음악)

questions.passage: As the days <u>passed</u>, Leo gradually regained his strength and playful spirit.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 passed의 문맥적 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: As the days passed = 날이 흐르면서(경과하면서)
det.analysis:
✅ ③ 경과하다, 흐르다: As the days passed = 시간이 흐르면서
❌ ① 지나다, 통과하다: 물리적 이동
❌ ② 합격하다: pass an exam
❌ ④ 건네다: pass me the salt
det.tip: pass: 경과하다(시간) | 통과하다(장소) | 합격하다(시험) | 건네다(물건)

questions.stem:
다음 영영풀이에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?
"to manage or give (a drug, treatment, etc.) to someone"

det.korean: '누군가에게 약이나 치료를 관리하거나 주다' → administer(투여하다)
det.analysis:
✅ ② administer: 영영 정의와 정확히 일치
❌ ① medication: 약 자체(명사)
❌ ③ infection: 감염(명사)
❌ ④ recovery: 회복(명사)
det.tip: administer = manage or give (treatment/drug) → 투여하다, 관리하다

questions.stem:
다음 영영풀이에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?
"causing overwhelming distress; extremely sad"

det.korean: '극도의 고통을 야기하는; 매우 슬픈' → heartbreaking(가슴 아픈)
det.analysis:
✅ ① heartbreaking: 영영 정의와 일치
❌ ② relieved: 안도한 → 반대 감정
❌ ③ anxious: 불안한 → 다른 감정
❌ ④ comfortable: 편안한 → 다른 감정
det.tip: heartbreaking = causing overwhelming distress = 가슴이 찢어지는, 매우 슬픈

questions.passage: The vet provided detailed instructions on how to administer the medication and shared tips for a speedy __________ (recover).
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 어법에 맞게 변형하여 쓰시오.

det.korean: recover(동사) → recovery(명사): 형용사 speedy 뒤에 명사가 필요하다.
det.analysis:
recover(동사) → recovery(명사)
a speedy _______ → 관사 a + 형용사 speedy 뒤에 명사 필요
det.tip: recover → recovery / discover → discovery — -er → -ery 명사화 패턴

questions.passage: Back at home, Christine created a __________ (comfort) space for Leo to rest and heal.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 어법에 맞게 변형하여 쓰시오.

det.korean: comfort(명사/동사) → comfortable(형용사): 명사 space를 수식하는 형용사 필요.
det.analysis:
comfort(명사) → comfortable(형용사)
a _______ space → 관사 a와 명사 space 사이에 형용사 필요
det.tip: comfort → comfortable / reason → reasonable — 명사 → -able 형용사 변환 패턴

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: Leo는 서서히 건강과 활발한 기질을 되찾았다(regained).
det.analysis:
✅ ② regained(되찾다): "gradually"와 자연스럽게 결합 → 서서히 회복
❌ ① declined(쇠퇴하다): 회복 상황과 반대

❌ ④ maintained(유지하다): 잃었다가 되찾은 것이므로 부적절
❌ ⑤ ignored(무시하다): 문맥과 무관

questions.passage: Christine was a cat owner who loved her furry companion, Leo. One morning, she noticed that Leo was not feeling well. Concerned for her beloved cat, Christine decided to take him to the animal hospital. As she always brought Leo to this hospital, she was certain that the vet knew well about Leo. (a)<u>She</u> desperately hoped Leo got the necessary care as soon as possible. The waiting room was filled with other pet owners. Finally, it was Leo’s turn to see the vet. Christine watched as the vet gently examined him. The vet said, “__________<u>I</u> think Leo has a minor infection.” “Infection? Will he be okay?” asked Christine. “We need to do some tests to see if he is infected. But for the tests, it’s best for Leo to stay here,” replied the vet. It was heartbreaking for Christine to leave Leo at the animal hospital, but (e)<u>she</u> had to accept it was for the best. “I’ll call (b)<u>you</u> with updates as soon as we know anything,” said the vet. Throughout the day, Christine anxiously awaited news about Leo. Later that day, the phone rang and it was the vet. “The tests revealed a minor infection. Leo needs some medication and rest, but he’ll be back to his playful self soon.” Relieved to hear the news, Christine rushed back to the animal hospital to pick up Leo. The vet provided detailed instructions on how to administer the medication and shared tips for a speedy recovery. Back at home, Christine created a comfortable space for Leo to rest and heal. (c)<u>She</u> patted him with love and attention, ensuring that he would recover in no time. As the days passed, Leo gradually regained his strength and playful spirit.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 (a)~(e) 중에서 가리키는 대상이 나머지 넷과 다른 것은?

det.korean: (a) She = Christine, (b) you = Christine (수의사가 Christine에게 말함), (c) She = Christine, (d) I = 수의사(vet), (e) she = Christine. 따라서 (d)만 수의사를 가리킨다.
det.analysis:
❌ ④ (d) I: 수의사가 말하는 “I think Leo has a minor infection”에서 I = 수의사
✅ (a) She: Christine이 간절히 바랐다
✅ (b) you: 수의사가 Christine에게 “I’ll call you”
✅ (c) She: Christine이 Leo를 쓰다듬었다
✅ (e) she: Christine이 받아들여야 했다
det.tip: 지칭 문제: 대화 속 인칭대명사의 화자/청자를 파악하는 것이 핵심. 수의사의 직접 발화 속 "I"는 수의사 자신.
